SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. OFFICE IN REGISTER / No. D H H 5 6 / Special Branch S.2. English / D.u. 15 / 2 / 33 / Date February 28. 1933）

Subject (in full). Reactionary publications entitled "Kuo Houn" (國魂) et al.

Made by.... D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa ....... Forwarded by.... [签名] D.I.

With reference to the attached file on the subject
of certain subversive publications entitled "Kuo Houn" (國魂),
"Hain Kin" (醒民) and "Min Sen" (民生) Weekly Magazines,
believed to emanate from the Youth League of the Chinese
Nationalism Party, I have to report that these publications
are unknown to this office. Endeavours made by the Chinese
staff of this Section to obtain copies from local bookstores
or newspaper vendors have been without success.

The above publications have been recorded by this
office for future reference.

（批：JR）

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch

File

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局 / 登记处办公室 / 编号 D H H 5 6 / 特务科 S.2. 英文 / D.u. 15 / 2 / 33 / 日期 1933年2月28日）

主题（全称）。题为《国魂》等之反动刊物。

呈报人.... 督察顾宝华 ....... 转呈人.... [签名] 督察。

关于随附档案中提及的若干颠覆性刊物，即题为《国魂》、《醒民》及《民生》周刊，据信系由中国国家主义青年团散发，本人谨此报告，本处对上述刊物并不知晓。本科华籍职员曾试图从本地书店或报贩处获取样本，但未获成功。

上述刊物已由本处记录在案，以备日后查考。

（批注：JR）

顾宝华
督察

特务科主管

REPORT
Date February 8, 1933.

Subject (in full) Reactionary Publication

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Prince.

Sir,
Inquiries by our staff of S. 5 have failed to find any of the publications mentioned in the attached on sale or being distributed in Shanghai. Due note of these papers "Kuo Houn" (國魂), "Hsin Min" (醒民) and "Min Sen" (民生) has been taken for future reference.

C. D. I.

O/C Special Branch.

S2,
Any information please?
J. Kirk.

OFFICIAL DISPATCH FROM THE BUREAU OF PUBLIC SAFETY.

January 25, 1933.

To the Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Sir,

This Bureau received a secret order from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, in which it is stated that the Anhui Provincial Government has communicated with the Ministry of Interior to the effect that the Bureau of Public Safety in Pangpu has reported a seizure of four kinds of reactionary papers entitled "Kuo Houn"(國魂), "Hsin Min" (醒民), and "Min Seng"(民生) Weekly Magazines and the "Manifesto To the People On the Chinese Nationalism Youth Corps' 9th Anniversary Meeting and on the Third Anniversary Of the Establishment of the Pangpu Branch"(中國國家主義青年團九週年紀念暨幹訓班開學三週紀念對民衆宣言). The Pangpu Bureau of Public Safety besides ordering an arrest of the dessiminating criminals at large, has submitted a petition requesting a suppression of the reactionary publication in order to check seditious propaganda.

The Ministry of Interior, in addition to transmitting this request to the Secretariat of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, has ordered the Municipality to ban the publication of the papers above-mentioned.

As this Bureau is ordered to carry out this prohibition, your are hereby requested to render assistance in this matter.
page_data.zh:
上海市公安局公函。

1933年1月25日。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处处长。

先生，

本局接到大上海市政府密令，其中指出安徽省政府已与内政部沟通，称蚌埠公安局报告查获四种反动报刊，即《国魂》、《醒民》、《民生》周刊，以及《中国国家主义青年团九周年纪念暨干训班开学三周年纪念对民众宣言》。蚌埠公安局除下令逮捕在逃的传播罪犯外，还提交请愿书，请求取缔该反动刊物，以遏制煽动性宣传。

内政部除将此请求转送中国国民党中央执行委员会秘书处外，已命令市政府禁止出版上述报刊。

鉴于本局奉命执行此项禁令，特此请求阁下在此事上提供协助。
